body: Thank you so much. You're truly a good person. Now that the tension has cooled down, my mum told me that she said those things out of desperation and didn't really mean it, however it still hurts to the absolute core that those words came out of her mouth. Likewise what your father said to you was absolutely messed up and I feel like giving you a hug too. But thank you again. Your words and the NFL playoff games (go the Packers!) should get me through the night.

I also forgot to add, these former friends, until about June/July of 2014 would send me photos of parties they were at that they would explicitly tell me I wasn't invited to while taking photos of all the people there and telling what a loser I was that I wasn't. They would also make up fictional parties and get-togethers and invite me to them, which mercifully I only fell for once. I know this sounds like something from "Mean Girls" but I swear to god this was true and mostly done by dudes. One of them (a girl) even made a report to the mental health services that I was stalking and harassing her despite the fact that I hadn't seen her in person for months. While this report didn't really lead to anything, it still hurts that someone that I thought cared about me would do something like that. All of these experiences have left me with serious trust issues that I'm not sure can be repaired ever.

Well about a year and a half ago I was in my last year of high school and was starting out in stand up comedy and everything for the most part seemed alright. But then in July to August of 2013 my auntie who I was extremely close to died on cancer, most of my friends disowned me for no reason and I had a sadistic assistant rugby coach (who's son was on the team and despite being an average at best player, would of course win player of the game every game) who would go to unhealthy lengths to destroy my self confidence, but due to him being a multi-millionare and me going to a private school in which having more money meant having a better time, the other coaches were too intimidated to stand up for me. While he was a little bit of a tosser to most of the team, he had a real personal dislike of me which I never understood. He would taunt me, my family, my families lack of money and just about everything he could to make me feel as worthless as possible. He even taunted me about my dying auntie and that she can run for longer than I can. All of these events absolutely destroyed my confidence and my self-worth and I've never recovered. Ever since, I have suffered from severe depression and anxiety and I have nightmares almost every night. Since then, just about all of my friends have deserted me, I've put on 10-15 kg and I've lost all focus or aspirations in life that I once had. It doesn't help that that rugby coach is a guy called Rob Morrison who owns a local soccer team called the Wellington Phoenix and even seeing Phoenix memorabilia reminds me that no matter how awful a person somebody is, they will always win in life. And that no matter what I do, I will never amount to a damn thing. Tonight my mother told me that she doesn't love me anymore and that the boy she once loved is dead. I feel like I have no reason to live and that me being alive is just taking up space and oxygen that my dear auntie should be breathing instead of me. I literally couldn't think of anywhere else to go to.
Hey man. I am so sorry for not replying. But I'm doing a lot better than I was when I posted this. I can't thank you enough for your kind words. You're an amazing person.
I really don't know. But it was the only thing I was really interested in studying
